Overview

Surat is a city in Gujarat with a population of 6,100,000. The diamond cutting and polishing capital of the world, also a major textile hub with a rapidly growing economy and infrastructure. Housing costs are close to the national average. Gardening thrives here — the 7a growing zone supports Mild — wide variety of vegetables, many fruit trees. The city enjoys abundant sunshine, with about 280 sunny days a year. The population skews young, with a median age of 28.0.
